model.initialization: original_pretrained_language_projection; fresh optimizer; discard P4.1 adapter for P4.2
model.frozen_parameters: all remaining named parameters, including query_tokens, vision_model, qformer and language_model

training_text.prompt: Question: What abnormalities are visible in this chest x-ray? Answer:
training_text.target: nonempty FINDINGS followed by nonempty IMPRESSION, joined with newline; reuse existing section parser
training_text.tokenization: one explicit BOS, separately tokenized prompt+separator and target with add_special_tokens=false, one terminal EOS
training_text.loss_mask: -100 for BOS, prompt, separator and padding; supervise report target and terminal EOS only
training_text.truncation: right-truncate target to leave room for terminal EOS; never truncate prompt; log affected studies

optimization.loss_scaling: none; preserve existing FP16 backbone/FP32 projection path
optimization.training_shuffle: single seeded permutation of frozen train manifest; save order and RNG state

cohorts.selection: first eligible unique studies in existing source order, not random sampling
cohorts.mimic_view_policy: first locally available AP/PA image per study in official split file order; do not prefer PA over AP
cohorts.indiana_policy: first eligible unique frontal X00 studies in existing cohort order with matching successful saved prediction and reference
cohorts.selection_bias_disclosure: source-order convenience pilot; no claim of random representativeness

generation.prompt: Question: What abnormalities are visible in this chest x-ray? Answer:
generation.historical_protocol_change_requiring_app: override checkpoint generation eos_token_id=50118 (newline) with tokenizer EOS=2, identically for M0 and M1
generation.validity_gate: 10 unique frozen studies: first five MIMIC validation and first five Indiana; both models, 20 generations counted in budget

evaluation.primary_lexical_metric: corpus BLEU-4 per dataset, paired M1-minus-M0; no pooling across datasets
evaluation.primary_clinical_policy: historical: exclude blank and uncertain labels, jointly definite reference/generated pairs
evaluation.coverage: per-model/class paired counts, positive support and undefined classes; report differing label masks
evaluation.undefined_f1: null with reason, never coerced to zero

bootstrap_cluster.indiana: study_id; patient ID unavailable in X00

evaluation.multiplicity: secondary metrics and CXR-LLaVA comparisons exploratory, unadjusted intervals, no confirmatory significance claims

blocking_decisions: approve prompt-conditioned report-only loss and exact token limits/EOS override
approve explicit optimizer defaults, no scheduler, microbatch/accumulation and frozen eval mode
approve source-order cohort candidates and seeded training permutation
